Class FieldMappingEngineTest

@IsTest
private class FieldMappingEngineTest

Test class for FieldMappingEngine. Validates field mapping functionality including JSON to SObject transformation, external ID lookups, required field validation, formula evaluation, and integration with Firestore and Stripe data mapping configurations.

Methods

@IsTest
private static void getFormulaValueBooleanTest()

Tests formula evaluation with Boolean return type. Validates that the getFormulaValue() method correctly evaluates Boolean formulas (ISBLANK) and returns the expected Boolean result.

@IsTest
private static void getFormulaValueDateTest()

Tests formula evaluation with Date return type. Validates that the getFormulaValue() method correctly evaluates Date formulas (TODAY) and returns the expected Date result.

@IsTest
private static void getFormulaValueDatetimeTest()

Tests formula evaluation with Datetime return type. Validates that the getFormulaValue() method correctly evaluates Datetime formulas (NOW) and returns the expected Datetime result.

@IsTest
private static void getFormulaValueDecimalTest()

Tests formula evaluation with Decimal return type. Validates that the getFormulaValue() method correctly evaluates Decimal formulas (ROUND) and returns the expected Decimal result.

@IsTest
private static void getFormulaValueIntegerTest()

Tests formula evaluation with Integer return type. Validates that the getFormulaValue() method correctly evaluates Integer formulas and returns the expected Integer result.

@IsTest
private static void mapRecordTest1()

Tests mapping Firestore venue data to Account records. Validates that JSON source data is correctly mapped to Account fields using the SYNC_FIRESTOREVENUE_ACCOUNT mapping configuration.

@IsTest
private static void mapRecordTest2()

Tests mapping Stripe invoice data to Invoice__c records with external ID lookups. Validates that the mapping engine correctly handles complex nested JSON structures, external customer references, and retrieves the correct external ID field for the child object.

@IsTest
private static void mapRecordTest3()

Tests required field validation for Stripe customer to Account mapping. Validates that the mapping fails when required fields (account name) are null or blank in the source data.

@IsTest
private static void mapRecordTest4()

Tests validation formula evaluation for Stripe customer to Account mapping. Validates that the mapping fails when the validation formula condition is not met (email and billing street are null).
